mech.summary:
MECH lane r3 verdict: PROTOTYPE, overall 6.5/10 (r2: 6.0). Next to the reference, about 20% of strangers would pick ours (r2: 15%). Not store-page ready. The pass gate fails: every axis is 7 or below, one instant tell is confirmed, and the verdict is not SHIPPING.

All 6 shots were captured fresh at 1600x900 with 0 console errors and 0 warnings. I also captured body_poses, mech_boss_showcase, mech_right_quarter, two in-engine close-ups (chest and legs) and a sub-pixel-shift shimmer pair.

**What r3 fixed**
- The back view is no longer crushed: mech bounding-box luminance went from 55 to 74.
- The dashed orange nozzle-throat arc is gone, replaced by a smooth radial throat glow.
- The rifle is now a heavy ribbed-jacket industrial gun instead of a scaled-up assault rifle.
- The feet have a toe segment.
- Wear and decals are now visible in-engine.
- QB, ground-skate and AB poses now have real body language: roll, trailing legs, and a skid crouch with foot sparks.

**New and remaining problems (in order of impact)**
1. **(S) The eye does not bloom.** This is a confirmed instant tell. The cyan lens is 1-2 px at a peak of RGB (185,214,213), dimmer than the amber head lamps beside it. The left-wrist lamp is the brightest emissive on the rig. This is a regression from r2's glowing slit.
2. **(A) Materials read near-new.** In-engine wear is pale mid-panel blotches with no metallic glint. There are no rust runs, grime gradient or nozzle soot, and the bone plates are clean.
3. **(A) Pain
tells: CONFIRMED - Eye with no bloom. mech_front.png head cab (x770-830, y230-265): the cyan lens peaks at RGB (185,214,213) on 1-2 px with no halo, below the adjacent amber marker lamps (200,168,144). In close_chest/mech_three_quarter.png the brightest pixels in the eye region are bezel speculars, not the

NOT CONFIRMED (borderline) - Boxes on boxes: the hands are stacked rectangular finger blocks (zoom/close_hand2x.png), and the feet are still box sleds, now with a toe segment and chevrons (zoom/tq_feet.png). The rest of the limbs have exposed drums and rams, so this is not a domain-wide hit.

NOT CONFIRMED - Panel-line shimmer: a 0.5 px camera-shift test (shimA vs shimB) changed only 0.29% of mech pixels by more than 40 levels, and the changes sit on geometric edges. The bolt rows stay stable.
NOT CONFIRMED - Low-poly cylinders: the cannon barrel, collars, ankle drums and nozzle bells are smooth at 4x zoom.
NOT CONFIRMED - Rigid stance: the idle in mech_front and mech_three_quarter is straight-legged and symmetric, but landing and QB compression are present (qb f30 crouch, f18 skid).

issues.problem: The sensor eye does not bloom; it is a 1-2 px dim cyan lens (instant tell). The brightest emissives on the rig are the left-wrist lamp and the amber head marker lamps.
issues.evidence: mech_front.png x770-830 y230-265: lens peak RGB (185,214,213) vs amber lamps (200,168,144). zoom/front_head4x.png, zoom/close_head4x.png (close_chest/mech_three_quarter.png). Wrist lamp 255,255,255 at close_chest x1115 y702. GLB eye node extras: iw_eye_strength 9, iw_eye_map 1; the A emissive atlas
issues.fix: In blender/mech, model a dedicated lens disc for the main pupil (0.16 m, 32 segments) and the second lens (0.09 m, 32 segments) under the eye node. Set iw_eye_map=0 so the rig uses a flat #8FF0FF emissive with no atlas lookup, and raise iw_eye_strength from 9 to 28. Add a 0.03 m-tall emissive core strip across the head vent slit at 50% of eye strength. Cut the hand_L wrist lamp and the head amber markers to 30% of their current emissive. Acceptance: at mech_front framing the lens is the brightest pixel cluster on the rig (display value >= 250) with a bloom halo of at least 6 px.

issues.problem: In-engine wear reads as pale paint blotches in the middle of panels with no metallic response. There are no rust runs, no grime gradient and no nozzle or louvre soot, and the bone plates are spotless, so the rig still reads near-new next to the look-dev.
issues.evidence: zoom/close_forearm2x.png (white blobs mid-panel on the rifle forearm); zoom/close_kneeplate4x.png (clean bone knee plate); zoom/back_nozzles.png and zoom/back_pack.png (no soot); compare assets/mech/preview/mech_player_close.png.
issues.fix: Build the wear mask from the baked curvature (convex > 0.6, dilated 2-5 cm) multiplied by noise, so chips only sit on edges and corners. In chip texels write metalness 1.0, roughness 0.35 and basecolor #8E9296, not light paint. Multiply basecolor by 0.65 over the lowest 2 m of the legs, and by AO^1.5 in crevices. Add 12-20 vertical rust-run decals (#6B3A22 fading to 0 over 0.4-1.2 m) below bolt rows on the shins, pauldrons and pack. Add a soot ring (basecolor x0.3, roughness 0.9) 0.4 m around each bell and over the back louvres. Put 10-15% grime and chipping on the bone plates as well.

issues.problem: Paint value and hue drift. Shaded faces go toy steel-blue, and sunlit faces in the QB frames wash to pale warm grey, so the rig never holds the dark slate-gunmetal weight of the palette.
issues.evidence: mech_three_quarter.png shaded thigh x720-760 y510-560 = #3A424C (sat 0.23) vs palette #3E4449 (sat 0.15). qb_sequence_f00-f12 (zoom/qb_strip.png) show a pale grey chest. cmp/mech_three_quarter.png shows the r2 vs r3 hue shift.
issues.fix: Re-author the slate basecolor at #34383B (sat <= 0.10, about 15% darker albedo) so sunlit faces land around sRGB #6A6A68 instead of about #9A9A98. Bake AO into the ORM R channel at full strength and set aoMapIntensity 1.0, so the sky/IBL fill is suppressed in recesses. Add roughness mottling 0.45-0.75 at 0.3-1 m scale so the key-light sheen breaks up instead of washing whole plates. Verify that a sunlit plate in qb f04 stays at display luma <= 120.

issues.problem: Large primary plates are under-detailed flat slabs: the back pauldrons, the lower chest skirt, the boss torso dome and the boss shin plates.
issues.evidence: zoom/back_lshoulder.png (pauldron is one flat slab with one small greeble); close_chest/mech_three_quarter.png lower chest skirt (dark flat plane with rectangular indents); zoom/boss_torso3x.png, zoom/boss_legs2x.png.
issues.fix: On every plate over 1.5 m, add 2-3 secondary insets (5-8 cm deep, 2 cm chamfer), a bolt row at 0.25 m pitch along the borders, and one functional greeble: a lifting eye with shackle (24 segments) on each pauldron top, tow lugs on the skirt, and a louvred heat-shield panel on the pauldron rear. On the boss, break the dome into 3 armour segments with seam gaps and add 2 vent grilles.

issues.problem: Knee and ankle rams are undersized chrome rods, and the hands are stacked box fingers, so the exposed-hydraulics, foundry-machinery language reads thin and toy-like.
issues.evidence: close_legs/mech_three_quarter.png (knee/shin pistons about 0.1 m diameter); zoom/close_hand2x.png (4 rectangular finger columns, flat-shaded).
issues.fix: Replace the leg pistons with 2 rams per knee and 1 per ankle: a 0.24 m barrel (32 segments, 1 cm bevel, painted slate) plus a 0.12 m chrome rod (roughness 0.2), clevis ends with 6 cm pins, and one hose loop per ram. Rebuild the hands as 3-segment fingers with 24-segment knuckle cylinders and 1 cm chamfers, or as an industrial clamp-grip with a palm actuator and a cable bundle.

issues.problem: Texel density of 87-94 px/m makes the stencils and wear smear at hero framing.
issues.evidence: zoom/shimmer_knee_AB.png: the knee '07' and 'CAUTION' are blurry at the 15 m hero shot. mech_player_report.json: texel_density_px_per_m 87.0; ORM B at 1024.
issues.fix: Move the stencils into a dedicated 2048 decal atlas packed tight to the stencil rects (about 400+ px/m on decals). Add a tileable 512 micro-scratch normal/roughness detail at 3-4 m tiling through the existing runtime detail shader, fading out beyond 40 m.

issues.problem: The mid-QB pose tucks the free knee up to hip height, which reads as a hop or kick rather than a jet-propelled lateral slide. The idle stance is symmetric and straight-legged, with the rifle arm held rigidly horizontal.
issues.evidence: zoom/qb_strip.png f04-f06 and zoom/qb_f06_hip4x.png (knee raised toward the camera); mech_front.png legs parallel and vertical; mech_three_quarter.png rifle arm horizontal.
issues.fix: In the rig.js QB pose layer, clamp lead-thigh pitch to <= 35 degrees. Abduct both hips 15-20 degrees away from the travel direction, pitch the trailing shin 20-30 degrees and the toe -25 degrees (toes down), and roll the torso 12 degrees away from travel. For the idle layer: 8-12 degree knee bend, feet staggered by 0.4 m and toed out 5 degrees, rifle arm lowered 20-25 degrees with a 15 degree elbow bend, and a 1.6 s breathing sway (torso pitch +/-0.5 degrees, pelvis bob 2 cm).

issues.problem: Decal and emissive bugs on the feet: the 'NO STEP 踏むな' stencil is upside-down to a viewer in front of the mech, and a thin orange emissive line runs along the left sole.
issues.evidence: zoom/close_ankle4x.png (inverted stencil); close_legs/mech_three_quarter.png x600-780 y715 (orange glowing sole strip).
issues.fix: Rotate the foot stencil UVs 180 degrees so it reads from the front. Remove the emissive on the sole edge, or replace it with a sooted vernier slot (basecolor x0.3, no emissive).

issues.problem: From the chase camera at 279 km/h the rig still reads mostly upright. The forward pitch is foreshortened from behind and the soles are never shown.
issues.evidence: zoom/chase_mech.png and cmp/chase_mech_r2_r3.png (gameplay_chase, rig x640-860 y460-690).
issues.fix: In the ground-boost pose layer, add 6-10 degrees of torso roll into the turn or strafe direction, raise the trailing heel 0.5-0.8 m so the sole and heel block catch light from the chase camera, and swing the rifle arm back 15 degrees with spring lag. Coordinate a longer white-core main plume with the VFX lane (out of the mech lane's scope).

world.summary:
WORLD round 3: PROTOTYPE, overall 6.4/10. About 15% of strangers would pick it over the reference; not store-page ready; does not pass.

Axis scores: composition 6 (tell), environment modeling 6 (tell), materials 6, lighting and atmosphere 7, image quality 6 (tell), art direction 7.

**What improved since round 2:**
- The rooftop box in q5 is now dressed with a louvre, vents and rails.
- The sea reads as grey water: (76,74,76) against r2's sand (119,98,88).
- The checkerboard in the q9 wet-patch specular is gone, and the q6 sandpaper aggregate became slab concrete.
- Stacks vary more.
- In gameplay_chase, the right third now keeps lit and shadow faces.

**Three instant tells remain:**
- **Plain extruded boxes:** an untextured diagonal conveyor ramp (q7 and title right), stepped far blocks (q6) and floating casthouse boxes (q8).
- **A void periphery:** the outer land is a flat, featureless plane with far kit floating on it and a hard horizon step (q8 upper right, arena_wide upper-left).
- **Aliasing:** guy wires and crane stays render as dotted pixels, corrugated walls show diagonal moiré (boss_fight, q7, title), and the q9 wet slab glitters.

**Other gaps against the reference:**
- **Sun-side wash:** structures at 150-300 m have zero contrast against the sky (q3: 146,116,100 vs 145,113,97), and no into-sun frame shows light shafts.
- **Rust:** every prop shares one salmon tone, (149,92,81) / (128,78,79).
- **Repetition:** the same furnace model appears three times in one fram
tells: Plain extruded boxes with no trim or texture: diagonal conveyor ramp in q7 (740-900, 430-540) and title right (1330-1600, 470-700); stepped far blocks in q6 (650-780, 230-410); floating casthouse boxes in q8 (1100-1600, 180-280). Caps environment modeling at 6.

Arena periphery reads as a void: the outer land is a flat, featureless plane with far kit floating on it and a hard horizon step, in q8 upper right (900-1600, 0-320) and arena_wide upper-left (0-450, 180-420). Caps composition and depth at 6.

Aliased edges / crawling specular. Sub-pixel guy wires and crane stays render as dotted pixels (q7 740-880, 120-260; arena_wide 820-1020, 190-340; q5 stack guys). Corrugated cladding shows diagonal moiré (boss_fight_f00 100-1100, 150-400; q7 170-560 x 290-500 in crop space; title 790-1000, 300-560).

scores.axis: image quality (AA, AO, shadows, bloom, grading)

issues.problem: The world outside the arena is an empty flat plane. Far furnaces, cooling towers and box clusters float on it with no ground contact, ending in a hard horizon step (instant tell: arena edge as void).
issues.evidence: fp/q8_high_east/arena_ground.png, upper right 900-1600 x 0-320 (far plane (162,129,110) against sky (198,148,120); a contrast-stretched crop shows a flat plane and a hard step at y~50 of v/q8_plane_ac.png). arena_wide.png upper-left 0-450 x 180-420 is a flat grey plain with a lighter slab.
issues.fix:
Build an outer terrain ring from 400 m to 3 km:
- A heightfield landmass with ±6-10 m undulation and a continuous shoreline mole.
- 3-4 instanced far-district kits (rail yards, 20-60 m sheds, tank clusters, gantries) at a density of ≥1 cluster per 150 m of horizon, so no empty plane exceeds ~10% of any frame.
- Under every far structure, a 4-8 m base skirt or plinth with a dark soot ground band.
- Blend the far ground into the haze with the existing farFade, so there is no plane-sky step.

issues.problem: Plain extruded boxes remain (instant tell): an untextured, flat-shaded diagonal conveyor ramp, stepped far blocks, and floating casthouse boxes.
issues.evidence:
- fp/q7_south_low: 740-900 x 430-540 (v/q7_center.png).
- title.png: right side 1330-1600 x 470-700 (v/ti_right.png).
- fp/q6_quay: 650-780 x 230-410 (v/q6_far.png).
- fp/q8_high_east: 1100-1600 x 180-280.
issues.fix: Replace the ramp with a conveyor-gallery kit: truss side frames in 1.2 m bays with diagonal bracing, a corrugated M_corr roof, an open walkway with a 1.1 m rail, belt idlers every 1.5 m, and a support bent every 18 m, all with steel trim UVs. Rebuild each stepped far block as a farkit silhouette carrying 3 detail frequencies: 6 m structural bays, louvre bands and roof monitors, then external stairs, pipe runs and stacks. Run a pass that finds any mesh with fewer than 3 materials or no trim UVs taller than 15 m and fixes it.

issues.problem: Sub-pixel geometric aliasing: guy wires, crane stays and distant lattice members rasterize as broken dotted pixels and will crawl in motion. SMAA cannot recover them.
issues.evidence: fp/q7_south_low 740-880 x 120-260 at 400% (v/q7_wire4.png: wire is a dotted line). arena_wide.png gantry cranes 820-1020 x 190-340 (v/aw_crane4.png). fp/q5_roof_sea stack guys (v/q5_far.png).
issues.fix:
Draw cables as camera-facing ribbons:
- Width = max(world radius, 1.5 px × viewDepth / focalPx).
- Alpha = trueWidth / drawnWidth (coverage), on the SOFT/transparent layer.
- This is the same rule as the FX lane's 2.2 px streak floor.

For lattice members beyond ~250 m, use a coverage-alpha LOD (merged plates with alpha-to-coverage, or a baked lattice card). Longer term: add a TAA-lite resolve that reuses the camera-motion reprojection already in the motion-blur pass, with 2-4-frame Halton jitter on static geometry.

issues.problem: Corrugated cladding aliases into diagonal moiré stripes instead of vertical ribs. It appears on every warehouse and mill wall and will shimmer in motion.
issues.evidence:
- boss_fight_f00.png: 100-1100 x 150-400 (v/bf_moire4.png at 400%).
- fp/q7_south_low: left building, v/q7_left.png 170-560 x 290-500.
- title.png: 790-1000 x 300-560.
issues.fix: In materials.js tri() for M_corr (scale 3.0), compute `ribLod = smoothstep(0.35, 0.9, fwidth(dot(wpos, ribAxis)) * 3.0 * ribsPerTile)`. Lerp the corr normal toward flat and the albedo toward its tile mean by ribLod, the same pattern already used for the slag veins at line ~623. Sample each triplanar projection with textureGrad and that projection's own derivatives so the mip choice is correct.

issues.problem: Sun-side wash: structures 150-300 m into the sun dissolve to sky value, and there are no volumetric shafts in into-sun views.
issues.evidence: fp/q3_sun/arena_ground.png: far tanks and buildings at 1150-1250 x 560-640 are (146,116,100) against sky (145,113,97), about 0 contrast (v/q3_far.png). fp/q11_west_sun_low and q3 show no shafts through the lattice and tower that backlight the sun. q12_ctrl_roof right third is a flat peach wash.
issues.fix:
Inside the ±45° sun sector:
- Raise ATMOS.fog.sunStart from 700 to ~1400 m and drop sunFloor from 0.12 to ~0.05.
- Cap sun in-scatter opacity at 0.5 for distances under 400 m, so shadow faces stay ≥15 L* below the sky.

Raise look.volume.dust by about 2x and dustRange from 160 to ~300 m, so occluders between camera and sun throw visible beams.

issues.problem: Every rail, plate stack, brick pile and wagon shares one uniform salmon 'rust'. It is off palette and reads as painted plastic.
issues.evidence: fp/q4_storm/arena_ground.png props sampled at sRGB (149,92,81) and (128,78,79). fp/q10_ground_close stacked plates (v/q10_ladle.png). Bent rails in boss_fight_f00 ground (v/bf_ground.png). Target palette #6B3A22 / #8C4A26 / #A2562B.
issues.fix:
Build the rust material from three palette tones:
- Mix #6B3A22, #8C4A26 and #A2562B by low-frequency noise.
- Put dark scale #3A2418 in crevices from a curvature/AO mask.
- Add bare steel #8E9296 on convex edges.
- Set roughness 0.75-0.95 with breakup noise.
- Cut value about 20% and saturation about 25% from the current base.

issues.problem: Kit repetition: the same blast furnace (curved downcomer and stove set) appears 2-3 times in a single frame.
issues.evidence: fp/q12_ctrl_roof/arena_ground.png at x 330-480, 620-700 and 1220-1380 (y 110-400). combat_rifle_f06.png far crop, two identical furnaces (v/cr_far.png).
issues.fix: Author 2 furnace variants: 3 stoves instead of 4, a straight downcomer with a dust catcher instead of the curved one, and a casthouse rotated 90°. Give each instance a random yaw and 0.85-1.15 uniform scale, and vary soot and tint per instance.

issues.problem: Ground-level frames lack a foreground layer: 30-45% of the frame is clean, empty slab.
issues.fix:
Scatter dressing across open yards at ≥1 prop cluster per 400 m² and ≥3 decal types per slab:
- Ash drift meshes plus soft-edge decals along walls and slab joints.
- Slag spill patches.
- Cable and hose runs.
- Track and tyre marks.
- Oil stains.
- Small puddles with sky reflection.

issues.problem: Low-poly and primitive props up close: the fallen converter end-cap is faceted, wagon wheels are faceted, and pipe-rack beams are plain box sections.
issues.evidence: fp/q10_ground_close converter at 440-545 x 170-370 (v/q10_ladle.png). fp/q9_tankfarm pipe-rack members 300-950 x 0-650.
issues.fix: Converter: 48 segments, a 2-segment bevel, trunnion rings and a lip. Wheels: 32 segments with spokes or discs. Pipe-rack beams: I-sections (flange plus web) with bolted gusset plates at each bent.

issues.problem: Wet slab specular is high-frequency glitter rather than a coherent wet sheen, and it will crawl in motion.
issues.evidence: fp/q9_tankfarm/arena_ground.png 950-1450 x 560-830 (v/q9_wet.png).
issues.fix:
Inside the wet mask:
- Flatten the slab normal to about 0.2 strength.
- Apply Toksvig / normal-variance specular AA, deriving roughness from the normal mip length.
- Add a cheap reflection term, either SSR-lite from the scene colour or a sky reflection by roughness, so puddles mirror structures.

issues.problem: The highlight budget is still far under target, and the flood masts are unlit props.
issues.evidence: L*>=65 share: arena_ground 0.67%, combat_rifle 1.9%, arena_wide 2.8% (target ~10%). arena_wide shows about 20 masts with no light pools (v/aw_ground.png).
issues.fix: Give each sodium mast (#FFB347) an additive projected light pool on the ground (decal or cone, 12-18 m radius) plus a small bloom-able lamp emissive. Add slag-channel glow and window warmth so 6-10% of a gameplay frame reaches L*>=65.

issues.problem: Water/shore interaction and windows read as cheap. There is no foam where the sea meets the quay or the sunk carrier's hull. Windows are flat uniform emissive panes beside pure black voids.
issues.evidence: fp/q6_quay hull waterline 650-1250 x 470-520 (v/q6_ship.png). fp/q5_roof_sea quay edge (v/q5_sea.png). fp/q2b wall, windows at 600-1280 x 40-560 (v/q2_zoom.png).
issues.fix:
- Shore and hull foam: a depth-difference foam band (#9AA3A1, 0.5-2 m) from scene depth, plus a hull wake decal.
- Windows: vary value ±30% per pane, add a grime gradient from the sill, and give unlit panes a sky-reflection term instead of black.

combat.summary:
The combat lane stays PROTOTYPE at round 3, with an overall score of 6.5 (r2 was 6). I estimate 12% of strangers would pick it over the reference game, and it is not store-page ready.

The project's `npm run shoot` timed out on its first frame because of shared-CPU load, so I rendered through a scratch wrapper around the same capture code. The game itself has no broken parts. I rendered all 7 required shots at 1600x900, plus 9 extra sequences, 3 dense frame runs, an edge-debug run and a run with motion blur off. All JSON sidecars show 0 console errors and 0 warnings, and telemetry passed.

**Real gains, verified at 200-400% zoom:**
- Exhaust jets are now visible, and the assault boost no longer blows the torso out into glare.
- The beige quick-boost cloud is gone, replaced by directional jets and a thin pressure ring on the ground.
- The coarse stipple the camera cutout used to leave on foreground masts is gone.
- The camera lens is narrower (54 base, 63 at the assault boost peak), which restores the heavy telephoto feel.
- The edge-debug run shows 0 magenta pixels in all 11 frames, and explosion smoke persists for 3 s or more.

**Movement numbers are still the strongest part (8):** every target in benchmark §3.4 is met. The deviations are the 54 base FOV and a 35 m camera distance against the 26-32 m spec.

**What still fails the pixels:**
- **Exhaust (6, capped by a tell):** at ab_launch f52, flat cutout dust sheets with bird-shaped silhouettes sit on the ground. The jets a
tells: Boost/AB exhaust VFX (benchmark 3.5c, visible sprite edges or shapes): at ab_launch f52 (lower centre, x680-780, y735-860 at 1600x900), 4-5 pale flat dust sheets with bird- or arrowhead-shaped torn-atlas silhouettes lie on the dark slab behind the AB rig. They read as paper cutouts, not dust, and th

issues.problem: The AB launch and wake dust uses flat world-aligned sheets whose torn-atlas silhouettes (bird and arrowhead shapes) read as paper cutouts on the ground. This is an instant tell that caps the exhaust axis.
issues.evidence: seq/ab_launch_f52.png, lower centre x680-780, y735-860; crops/ab_launch_f52_flakes.png at 400%
issues.fix:
1. Stop emitting world-aligned ground sheets for AB launch and wake. Use camera-facing billow puffs instead (atlas variants 0-3, alpha 0.12-0.18, size 3-6 m, sizeVar 0.5, rotation randomised per particle and rotating at 0.3 rad/s).
2. If any ground sheet stays, multiply its alpha by smoothstep(0.2, 0.6, abs(dot(N, V))) so it vanishes at grazing angles.
3. Window those sheets with the radial (1-r^2)^1.5 falloff in the sheet's local UV, not only the atlas alpha, so the cell silhouette is never the visible edge.

issues.problem: The heat haze refracts the player rig itself and is too strong. It smears the legs and armour with RGB fringes and bends background lattice into S-curves.
issues.evidence: nomblur/ab_launch_f52.png rig, legs smeared with fringes (crops/ab_launch_f52_rig_nomblur.png); dense/ab_flight_f02.png gantry leg bent ~10 px (crops/dense_ab_f02_haze_x4.png); dense/qb_chase_f00.png ground ripple with fringes left of the rig (crops/qb_chase_f00_f00blob.png)
issues.fix:
1. In distort.js APPLY_FRAG, read the scene depth at vUv + off and at vUv. Zero the offset unless both depths are at least 2 m beyond the haze sprite's view depth, so only the background behind the plume refracts.
2. Also zero the offset inside the player-rig screen box the motion-blur pass already uses.
3. Lower the max-offset clamp from 0.007 to 0.0025 UV and the chromatic factors from 1.06/0.94 to 1.015/0.985.
4. Lower JET.hazeAB from 0.55 to 0.25 and hazeBoost from 0.35 to 0.18.

issues.problem: The exhaust jets are flat projected 2D blades. Main bells show a horizontal smear not aligned to the bell axis, the AB flames splay in a V like antlers, and no shock diamonds are visible anywhere. The plume has no volume end-on.
issues.evidence: seq/vfx_boost_close_f00.png bells (crops/vfx_boost_close_f00_bells.png); boost_ground_f10.png rig at x510-770, y470-700 (jets read as tracer-like streaks); ab_flight_f00/f10.png centre, V flames
issues.fix:
1. Fade the fx.jet quad by (1 - abs(dot(jetDir, viewDir)))^0.7.
2. For the end-on share, draw a soft nozzle-exit disc: radial core #FFF4D6 to #FF6A1A, diameter 1.2x the bell, with a 6-sample flicker.
3. Rely on the flame.js lathe-shell raymarch for depth, so a jet pointing at the lens reads as a glowing throat plus a short cone, not a sideways blade.
4. Make the shock diamonds legible: 3 nodes at 0.3/0.6/0.9 of the core length, 1.6x brightness, 0.25 m long.
5. Lengthen the main-bell core in ground boost to 2.5-3 m.

issues.problem: On QB frames 0-1 the thrusting-side flare saturates into a hard-edged white cone (a megaphone shape) that reads as a mesh, not hot gas.
issues.evidence: dense/qb_chase_f00.png and f01.png at about x540-600, y400-450 (1280x720); crops/qb_chase_f00_f00blob.png
issues.fix:
1. Clamp the HDR peak of rig.flare() during QB so the lathe shell tops out near 4.0 before tone mapping.
2. Add a silhouette falloff to the plume shader: alpha *= pow(1 - abs(dot(N, V)), -1) replaced by smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, abs(dot(N, V))), so shell edges fade instead of cutting.
3. Put the frame-0 punch into a 2-frame star flash sprite (QB_JET.flash, 1.2-1.6 m, white core) plus the existing pressure ring.

issues.problem: In the blade kill, the target MT blows out to a flat pure-white silhouette with jagged edges. The pulse-blade arc is a uniform-width glossy tube about 30 m long that does not change from f0 to f8.
issues.evidence: blade_hit_f00.png centre x530-700, y480-690 (0.65% of the frame at 255 white); crops/blade_hit_f00_fireball.png; seq/vfx_blade_close_contact.png f0-f8
issues.fix:
1. Scale the impact fx.flash point-light intensity by 1/(d^2 + 4) with a ceiling of 8 at the target.
2. Agree with the enemy lane to cap the hit-pulse emissive near 1.5 so the hull keeps gradation.
3. Limit the arc to the blade's reach: a 10-12 m crescent sweeping 110-140 deg.
4. Taper the width 0 to 1 to 0 along the arc, and scroll a noise erosion mask along it.
5. Set the arc life to 0.12 s plus a 2-frame afterglow.
6. Emit 40-60 spark streaks along the cutting edge at contact.

issues.problem: From the gameplay camera the rifle barely registers. The muzzle flash is about 10 px and occluded by the torso, the tracer is visible on only 2 frames per shot, and there are no casings or muzzle smoke.
issues.evidence: dense/combat_rifle_f11-f14.png at the right forearm (crops/dense_rifle_muzzle.png); combat_rifle_f06.png shows only sparks at the target; seq/vfx_rifle f00-f14 show no casings or smoke
issues.fix:
1. For the player's own rounds, raise the tracer minimum screen length from 20 to 45 px and the width to 3 px, and keep each tracer alive at least 3 rendered frames.
2. Raise rigFlash intensity from 26 to 40 with range 16.
3. Add an ejected casing per shot: instanced 6 cm brass mesh, ejected to the right and up at 6 m/s, gravity, 1.5 s life.
4. Add a 0.6 s grey muzzle smoke puff per shot (atlas variants 4-7, alpha 0.25, inheriting owner velocity).

issues.problem: The explosion fireball is 2-3 discrete popcorn lobes. The debris is untextured grey faceted shards, and the sparks are straight dashes and round dots.
issues.evidence: seq/vfx_explosion_seq_f08.png and f16.png centre; crops/vfx_explosion_seq_f30_embers.png
issues.fix:
1. Spawn 8-12 overlapping fire-flipbook instances (sizeVar 0.5) at staggered erode phases so the lobes merge into one rolling mass.
2. Use the textured debris chunks with an emissive scorched-edge mask and a smoke trail on the biggest 3.
3. Make spark arcs visible: gravity 20 m/s^2, life 0.6-0.9 s, initial speed 25-40 m/s.
4. Drop the round glow dots to under 30% of the spark count.

issues.problem: Missile smoke stays near-white cream at constant density and width along its whole length. It does not darken, widen or drift with age, and the missile-kill smoke is compact black balls.
issues.evidence: seq/vfx_missiles_seq_f40.png and f120.png (crops/vfx_missiles_seq_f40_ribbon.png); f70 dark round puffs
issues.fix:
1. Ramp the trail colour by age from #C8C4BE to #6D6A66 by 2 s.
2. Grow the width 3x over life and decay alpha to 0 by 3.5 s.
3. Add a 2 m/s wind drift plus fBm lateral wander.
4. For the kill smoke, use 5-7 puffs with sizeVar 0.6 rising at 3 m/s, not one compact cluster.

issues.problem: The QB and skid ground wake is a dotted line of evenly spaced isolated dust pillars, not a continuous drag streak.
issues.evidence: qb_sequence_f30.png path region x520-1000, y480-600 (crops/qb_sequence_f30_dust.png)
issues.fix:
1. In movefx.js, emit by travelled distance every 0.6 m with ±0.5 m lateral jitter.
2. Stretch the puffs 2.5x along the ground velocity and keep them low (height 0.4x width).
3. Use alpha 0.15-0.25 with life 1.2-2 s, so overlapping puffs form a continuous rooster tail.

issues.problem: The camera deviates from §3.4: base FOV 54 instead of 50, and the orbit distance is 35.3 m against the 26-32 m spec. QB shake peaks at only 0.0074 rad, so the burst carries little camera impulse.
issues.evidence: telemetry.json: cam_dist_idle_m 35.271, boost_fov_deg 57.98, qb shake max 0.00739 (telemetry.csv)
issues.fix:
1. Try a 50 deg base with the orbit at about 33 m and the pivot lowered 0.5 m, keeping the rig at 24-28% of frame height (verify rig_frame_pct_*).
2. Raise the QB shake to 0.012 rad decaying over 0.15 s, with a directional 0.4 m lateral camera kick opposite to the burst.

ui.summary:
Verdict: PROTOTYPE, overall 6.5/10, pass = false. About 30% of strangers would pick ours over the reference (25% in r2). Not store-page ready.

Every r2 issue is fixed and confirmed in the pixels. The warning banner now holds about 5.0:1 contrast with steady text (only the rules and chevrons blink). Alert chips keep fixed left/centre/right slots, and MISSILE ALERT and LOCK WARNING show from launch. The target readout no longer parks on the player's rig. The boss AP number moved to the name row and the two bars share edges at x524/x1076. The vitals labels align at x571. The briefing grid letters, AO LIMIT label and scale bar no longer collide, and the menus keep a 5% safe margin.

What still fails:
- **New HUD tell.** In motion/hud_alerts_f18.png the target readout slides onto its own FCS bracket, and lock digit '1' sits 6 px from '1,000', reading '1 1,000'. The readout also hops left, then above, then above-right within 0.3 s, and has no leader line when two targets are close. This caps HUD readability at 6.
- **Title regression.** The 5% inset was bought by doubling the letterbox to 23.9% of the frame (r2: 11.1%) in crushed #040506 black.
- **HUD weight.** Long pale reload rules and plates form a box around the reticle, a debug-like QB/AB/BOOST/STANDBY row sits under EN, and the large numerals use generic Share Tech Mono. The design reads as AA, not as the reference.
- **Results.** Solid and animated, but the blurred background is undifferentiated mud.
- **Audio.** Technical
tells: HUD+UI §3.7(c) 'text that overflows or overlaps': motion/hud_alerts_f18.png, centre (x730-880, y377-442). The target readout plate covers the top edge of its own FCS bracket (y423), and lock-order digit '1' (x821-827) sits 6 px from AP '1,000' (x833-872), reading as '1 1,000'. This caps the readabil

Checked and NOT present: default serif or Arial fonts (all three vendored faces loaded); opaque HUD panels over 12% (weapon and readout plates are translucent; the title letterbox is judged as framing, not a HUD panel); rainbow bars; emoji; width-jittering numbers (mono digits); missing damage or al

scores.axis: audio design (from spectrogram sheet + code review)

issues.problem: When the target readout changes slot it slides onto its own FCS bracket and the lock-order digit. The digit '1' merges with the AP number into '1 1,000'. The readout also hops three slots in 0.3 s while the target barely moves.
issues.evidence: motion/hud_alerts_f18.png x730-880 y377-442: plate over the bracket top (y423); '1' at x821-827 next to '1,000' at x833-872. z/a_tg_seq.png: left slot at f12/f15, above at f18, above-right at f24/f30.
issues.fix: In src/ui/layout.js placeReadout, add the target's own bracket box (bracket half-size + 6 px) and its index-digit box to the collision rects for EVERY candidate, including 'above' and 'below'. Move .mk-idx to outside the bracket's bottom-right corner. Add time hysteresis: keep the current slot until it has collided for 0.35 s of sim time. On a slot change, never glide through the target: fade out over 80 ms, reposition, then fade in over 120 ms. Add a unit test that sweeps target and marker positions and asserts zero rect intersection between the readout and any bracket or digit.

issues.problem: With two targets close together it is unclear which one the readout describes, because it floats between them with no connector.
issues.evidence: hud_full.png: readout x837-992 y343-405; its bottom edge is about equidistant from bracket 1 (x758-818, y423-483) and marker 2 (x905-950, y425-485). The same holds in hud_alerts_f24/f30.
issues.fix: Draw a 1 px #E6EEF0@60% dog-leg leader (45° then horizontal, at most 60 px) from the readout's nearest corner to the matching bracket corner. Score candidate slots by distance to the nearest OTHER marker (prefer the side away from it), not just by first collision-free slot.

issues.problem: The title met the 5% safe inset by doubling the letterbox to 23.9% of the frame. The bars are crushed near-black (#040506), the hero scene is a 2.34:1 strip, the rig shrank, and the status and footer float in dead black.
issues.evidence: title.png rows 0-107 and 793-900 (median luma below 12); r2 11.1%, r3 23.9% (cmp/title.png).
issues.fix: Cut each bar to at most 54 px (6%), or remove the bars and use a #0B0F12 gradient (0 to 80% over the outer 14%) on top of the scene. Position the footer and status at a 5% inset over that gradient with a 35% plate. Set the minimum bar colour to #0B0F12 so the frame respects the #1C2126 black lift. Re-frame the hero camera so the rig fills about 60% of frame height.

issues.problem: The weapon cluster is heavier than REF. Four long pale reload rules and gradient plates frame the reticle in a visible 890x290 px box, so the HUD reads as boxes instead of floating hairline text.
issues.evidence: hud_full.png x354-1246 y300-590: rules 176x3 px at y364-367 and y586-588; plates with a 1 px inner edge at x540 and x1059 (z/h_wpnL, z/h_wpnR).
issues.fix: Make the reload bars 2 px tall at 70% alpha and 96 px long, anchored to the digits' outer edge. Remove the plates or drop them to 15% alpha, and use text-shadow 0 0 3px rgba(11,15,18,.7) for legibility. Pull the blocks about 30 design px toward centre (TG_STATIC ±206..366 to about ±180..330), and update TG_STATIC to match.

issues.problem: A permanent state-chip row under the EN bar ('QB', 'AB', 'BOOST', plus 'STANDBY' or 'GROUND BOOST') reads like a debug readout and clutters the most-watched area.
issues.evidence: hud_full.png and gameplay_chase.png x588-1013 y705-723.
issues.fix: Remove the always-on chips. Show the QB cooldown as a 2 px sweep inside the EN bar, and show 'BOOST' or 'ASSAULT BOOST' as a single tag that fades in and out over 1.5 s on state change. Never show 'STANDBY'.

issues.problem: The large numerals use Share Tech Mono, a recognisable free 'sci-fi' face that clashes with the Barlow Condensed labels and cheapens the AP readout and ammo counts.
issues.evidence: hud_full.png '8,400' (x586-673, y608-639), '06'/'17' (28.75 px); options.png preview.
issues.fix: Set the big numerals (AP, magazine, timers, results values) in Barlow Semi Condensed 500 with font-feature-settings 'tnum' 1 and 'zero' 0 (vendored @fontsource/barlow-semi-condensed). Keep Share Tech Mono only for small 13-15 px telemetry such as range and reserve.

issues.problem: The own STAGGER row disappears completely when empty, so the vitals block changes silhouette between frames and leaves a 38 px unlabeled hole between AP and EN.
issues.evidence: hud_full.png y656-688 is empty; gameplay_chase.png shows the row at y665-679.
issues.fix: Always render the STAGGER track at 12% alpha with its label at 60%. Brighten both only when the value is above 0.

issues.problem: Japanese line breaks split katakana words, and the briefing loadout lists slots in R, L, L, R order, which contradicts the HUD's spatial logic.
issues.evidence: controls.png FIELD NOTES 'ミサ/イル' (y516-536) and 'ポー/ズ' (y608-628). briefing.png loadout x690-1520 y738-765: R-ARM, L-ARM, L-BACK, R-BACK.
issues.fix: For JP blocks use word-break: keep-all and line-break: strict, and insert <wbr> at phrase boundaries (budoux-style segmentation done at build time). Reorder the loadout to L-BACK, L-ARM | R-ARM, R-BACK.

issues.problem: The results and menu backgrounds are blurred and darkened so much that the scene is unreadable mud, which wastes the in-engine backdrop and leaves big dead areas.
issues.evidence: results_win.png and results_lose.png x900-1600: about 95% of pixels fall in #141210-#2A2520; there is a dead band at x900-1200.
issues.fix: Halve the blur radius, keep a 55% darken on the left 60% only (horizontal gradient), and frame the rig silhouette behind the rank box (heroCamera offset) so the right third reads as a scene.

issues.problem: The blade, blade_hit and stagger cores still show evenly spaced harmonic combs and regular amplitude modulation, which is a synth-patch signature rather than a designed plasma or metal sound.
issues.evidence: audio/audio_sheet.png: blade panel (stacked harmonics 100 Hz-3 kHz for 0-0.5 s, a regular waveform buzz), blade_hit 'FM metal shear' comb lines 100 Hz-10 kHz, stagger ~12 Hz periodic striations.
issues.fix: Replace the saw/FM cores with noise-excited resonator banks on inharmonic ratios (reuse SCRAP-style ratios, Q 12-30). Add 2-4% slow random pitch drift (smoothed noise LFO, not a sine) and a band-limited crackle layer at 2.5-6 kHz. For blade_hit, use 6+ modal partials with decays of 0.1-0.6 s and randomise ±15% per variant.

issues.problem: Rifle shots are dry. There is no outdoor slap or echo tail, while REF guns carry a long environmental echo.
issues.evidence: audio/audio_sheet.png rifle panel: RMS reaches -60 dB at about 0.35 s. The music sheet 'rifle x8' demo shows tails under -40 dB within about 0.3 s of each shot.
issues.fix: Add an 'echo' layer per variant: 2-3 band-passed (300 Hz-2 kHz) delayed copies at 90-260 ms (randomised per variant) at -14, -20 and -26 dB, panned ±40°. Raise the rifle reverb send from 0.3 to 0.42, scaling with listener-to-wall distance.

issues.problem: LEDGER's TTS voice-over has machine-regular formant bands and syllable timing, so it reads robotic even through the radio chain.
issues.evidence: audio/audio_sheet_music.png COMMS panels 'boss'/'start': formant stripes are evenly spaced and of uniform length per syllable.
issues.fix: In vo_prosody.py add F0 jitter of 0.6% and shimmer of 3%, vary syllable durations ±15%, add breath noise (pink, -30 dB, 120 ms) at phrase starts, and add 1-2 Hz vibrato only on phrase-final vowels. Re-bake through the same radio chain.

enemies.summary:
Overall 6.0, up from 5.5 in r2, but no axis reaches 8. Verdict PROTOTYPE: about 10% of strangers would pick ours over the pre-registered reference frames, and it is not store-page ready. The pass gate fails: a §3.6 tell remains (the boss and the GNAT drone are lower fidelity than the player rig), along with boss edge sparkle and a glow-soup limiter flare.

**What genuinely improved (verified in the pixels):**
- The whole-body cream hit flash is gone, replaced by a local emissive pulse with surface sparks (cam/mt_hit_f18).
- The stagger ring now sits on the ground, so the screen-wide blue band is gone, and the stagger bolts branch (extra/boss_stagger_window_f00).
- MT deaths are layered, leave textured debris and an authored wreck plate, and the scorch decal is much less dithered.
- The MT got leg bolts, chips and hazard stripes, and its sensor slit is now visible.
- The boss missile salvo reads at 79 m with a MISSILE ALERT banner.
- The squad has bite again: 33.3% of rounds hit and 6 evasive skates (was 1 hit in 21 shots and 0 evades).

**What still fails:**
1. The CINDERHOUND model has not changed since r2: 69k tris and 7 decals against the player's 90k and 48. It still has flat oxide planes and near-white shin cards.
2. Combat readability is poor:
   - The MT at 74 m is about 42 px under the reticle, and a hit spark buries it.
   - In boss_fight_f00 the boss is cut in half by a lamp pole at 30 m.
   - At 21 m the boss sparkles with single-pixel speckles.
3. The limiter rele
tells: §3.6 'Enemies rendered at lower fidelity than the player': the CINDERHOUND boss is 69k tris / 7 decals against the player's 90k / 48. boss_closeup.png 620-1000,180-470 shows large flat oxide torso and pauldron planes, smooth blob toe claws and near-white bone shin cards; mech_three_quarter.png has d

§3.1 'Texture shimmer or aliasing on panel lines at 1080p' (applied to enemy rigs): in boss_fight_f10 the boss at 21 m (crop 690-890,380-520) is covered in isolated orange and white single-pixel speckles along every edge, which reads as specular or rim aliasing on the detail normal.
§3.1 'Limbs that are simply boxes on boxes' (borderline, MT): the leg armour is stacked rounded tiles on a hidden frame, with a ram on one leg only (enemy_mt_f20 600-1000,460-860; enemy_mt_legs_f00).

§3.3-style glow soup on a boss event: the limiter-release flare in boss_phase2_f00 450-950,220-620 is a ~450x350 px pink-white burst that blanks the boss (8.4% of the frame bright warm, 2.9% near-white).

issues.problem: The rival rig GC-X1 CINDERHOUND is still visibly below the player rig's detail density. This §3.6 instant tell caps two axes at 6. The geometry is unchanged since r2.
issues.evidence: extra/boss_closeup.png 620-1000,180-470 (pass/bc_torso.png) and 660-820 legs (pass/bc_legs.png) against extra/mech_three_quarter.png (pass/player_torso.png). Asset reports: boss 68,976 tris / 7 decals, player 89,762 tris / 48 decals.
issues.fix: Add the secondary frequency on the chest, pauldrons and hips: boolean inset panels of 0.2-0.6 m with 2-3 cm two-segment bevels, two heat-shield louvre banks over the back boosters, exposed hip and ankle hydraulic rams (32 segments, chrome roughness 0.25), and lifting eyes and tow shackles. Raise the decals to at least 35: load-rating stencils, hazard chevrons, serials and a Grauwerk emblem on one pauldron. Bake rust streaks below bolts and soot near the nozzles. Re-chamfer the toe claws as hard three-edge bevels instead of soft blobs. Pull the bone shin and knee plates' albedo from near-white down to #BDB39A and add edge wear and a grime gradient, so they stop reading as blown white cards. T

issues.problem: Enemies remain hard to read in real combat framing. A target at 74 m is ~42 px under the reticle, the impact spark buries the whole body on hit, and the boss gets parked behind thin occluders.
issues.evidence: combat_rifle_f06.png 700-880,390-500 (pass/cr_mt_pair.png): the f06 spark covers the MT completely. boss_fight_f00.png 750-840,400-495: the boss at 30 m is cut in half by a lamp pole and the bracket.
issues.fix: (a) Add a far-range outline for enemies at more than 60 m from the camera: an inverted-hull or stencil edge of 1-1.5 px in #1A1A1A at 60% alpha. (b) Cap the impact-spark sprite on the locked target to 35% of the target's screen height and offset the burst toward the shooter, so the silhouette survives. (c) Add a camera-line-of-sight term to boss positioning. Each 0.25 s, ray from the player camera to the boss chest. If a thin occluder (pole or girder under 3 m wide) blocks it for more than 0.5 s, bias the strafe direction to clear it.

issues.problem: The rival is not a threat and phase 2 does not hold its own range. Boss missiles never connect, GNATs barely shoot, and a strafing bot always wins comfortably.
issues.evidence: ailog/ai_log.json. P2 band [25,60] m is held 33% of the time (median 71 m, peaks 137 m on the ai_log.png timeline). hitsOnPlayer.boss_missile = 0 over 6 salvos. GNATs fire 2 shots in the whole squad stage. No-godmode bot wins 6/6 with 3,430-6,780 AP left. Squad coverPlans = 0.
issues.fix: Raise the P2 radial gain and make escape and flank QBs pick directions that end inside [25,60]; target at least 60% in band. Time missile salvos to the player's QB cooldown: fire when the player's QB cooldown has more than 0.3 s left, and add a second salvo 0.4 s later from the other shoulder with a 25 deg lateral spread. Give GNATs one 6-round burst every 2.5 s in orbit, behind a 0.5 s laser tell. Tune until the no-godmode bot wins about 4/6 and ends below 25% AP.

issues.problem: The limiter-release beat blanks the boss with an oversized pink-white starburst (glow soup) instead of staging it.
issues.evidence: extra/boss_phase2_f00.png 450-950,220-620 (pass/p2_flare.png): the burst is ~450x350 px and the boss at 81 m is invisible. 8.4% of the frame is bright warm and 2.9% near-white. Source: boss.js _vent() spawns iw_eye_flare at scale 1.4 plus iw_vent.
issues.fix: Clamp the eye flare to a screen-space radius of 60-90 px (scale by distance / BOSS_EYE-style clamp). Replace the vent flash with world-scaled coolant jets from the booster nozzles (fx.jet, 6-10 m long, white-to-#9FB3BA steam) lasting 1.2 s. Keep the boss silhouette and red sensor readable throughout the callout.

issues.problem: The GNAT drone is the lowest-fidelity unit in the stage. It has a smudgy flat body bake, a plain visor slab, a toy candy-striped gatling and a salmon disc eye.
issues.evidence: enemy_drone_f00.png 640-960,290-660 (pass/drone_body.png), duct 370-690,280-510 (pass/drone_duct.png) and extra/enemy_drone_under.png (pass/drone_under_body.png).
issues.fix: Cut vents and louvre banks plus 2-3 cm bevelled panel insets into the body flanks. Recess the visor slab into a framed housing with bolts. Replace the white barrel bands with dark machined gunmetal cooling fins (24+ segments) and a slotted muzzle brake. Make the lens a deep #FF2A2A core with a dark iris ring and a thin bright rim, not a flat salmon disc. Raise the body texel density to match the MT (at least 120 px/m at 2048) with an edge-wear and grime pass.

issues.problem: Specular and rim sparkle appears on the boss at combat distance: isolated bright single pixels crawl along edges.
issues.evidence: boss_fight_f10.png 690-890,380-520 (pass/bf_f10_boss.png): orange and white single-pixel speckles over the whole silhouette at 21 m.
issues.fix: In the enemy material patch (models.js rim/detail chunk), fade the tiling micro-detail normal and the distance rim by screen-space footprint, i.e. fwidth(vViewPos)/texel. Add Toksvig-style roughness widening (roughness = max(r, length(fwidth(N))*k)). Clamp the far rim to 0.5. Verify that no isolated pixel exceeds 1.5x the local 3x3 mean luminance.

issues.problem: MT walkers show no physical flinch on ordinary hits. The hit reaction is only VFX.
issues.evidence: cam/mt_hit_f15-f27.png (pass/mt_hit_sheet.png): AP drops 790 to 685 at f18, yet the stride and turret pose are unchanged and the position advances a constant 0.4 m per 3 frames.
issues.fix: In makeAnimator(), add an additive hit recoil. Pitch and roll the hull 3-5 deg away from the impact direction on a spring with 0.15 s settle, add 2 deg of turret yaw jitter, and add a 60 ms stride hitch (gait phase hold) on hits of 80+ damage.

issues.problem: Death debris reads as grey concrete rocks, not Grauwerk armour, and the authored wreck plate is a flat white card.
issues.evidence: extra/enemy_mt_death_f08.png 820-1100,100-380 (pass/death_f08_debris.png). extra/enemy_mt_death_f200.png 960-1110,730-780 'P-27' plate (pass/death_wreck.png).
issues.fix: Build the debris_<n> chunks from the MT's own panels: bent oxide-and-cream painted plates 4-6 cm thick, with torn, burnt edges, exposed bare metal on the break lines and a hazard-stripe fragment. Give the P-27 plate thickness, a scorched gradient and a bent corner.

issues.problem: The MT leg armour still reads as stacked rounded tiles floating on a hidden frame, with a hydraulic ram on only one leg.
issues.evidence: enemy_mt_f20.png 580-1060,440-880 (pass/mt_legs.png) and extra/enemy_mt_legs_f00.png.
issues.fix: Replace the pillowy pads with hard-chamfered plates (two-segment 1-2 cm bevel). Expose the inner frame between them (actuator discs, a 24-segment knee ram on both legs, a cable loom). Add a shin load-rating stencil ('MAX 12t').

issues.problem: The wreck scorch decal still shows a regular wormy stipple when zoomed, and the stagger burst is a uniform starburst of straight needles.
issues.evidence: extra/enemy_mt_death_f200.png 760-960,640-760 at 4x (pass/death_scorch4x.png vs r2 pass/r2_death_scorch4x.png); extra/boss_stagger_window_f00.png 600-1100,100-760.
issues.fix: Pre-blur or regenerate the burn channel of the misc atlas as a low-frequency fBm (no 1-px periodic pattern), and sample it with a soft edge. For the stagger burst, randomise streak length 0.4-1.6x, add 30% curved sparks with gravity, and lean on the branching bolts instead of radial needles.

issues.problem: The boss blade approach holds one locked crouch pose for 0.7 s+, which reads as a sliding statue.
issues.evidence: cam/boss_track_f00-f36.png (pass/boss_track_sheet.png): the same leg and arm pose in every frame while boosting in at 20-30 m.
issues.fix: Drive the bosspose layer through the approach. Run a 0.35 s wind-up that progressively draws the blade arm back (0 to 35 deg), give the trailing leg a 4 deg / 2 Hz flutter and the torso a small lateral weave from accelLocal, then snap into the lunge at the tell end.
